# Parent ApS

> > All-in-one childcare management platform for preschools combining billing, parent communication, attendance tracking, and child development monitoring.

Parent ApS is a comprehensive SaaS solution designed for preschools and childcare centers across multiple regions (North America, Europe, Middle East). The platform integrates staff scheduling, billing automation, real-time parent communication, and child development tracking into a single unified system.

## Key Topics

- Childcare Management
- Billing Automation
- Parent Communication
- Attendance Tracking
- Child Development Tracking
- Preschool Software
- Team Management
- Daily Reports
- Curriculum Builder
- Invoicing & Payments
- Waitlist Management
- Staff Scheduling
- SaaS Platform
- Early Childhood Education
- Kindergarten Management

## Core Platform

- [Parent ApS: Preschool & Childcare Management Software](https://parent.app): Parent main homepage for all-in-one preschool management software
- [Pricing](https://www.parent.app/pricing): Parent pricing plans with feature comparison and integration options

## Key Features

- [Childcare Billing Automation Software](https://www.parent.app/childcare-billing-automation-software): Childcare billing automation with invoicing and payment processing
- [Parent Communication App](https://www.parent.app/preschool-parent-communication-app): Parent-teacher communication platform with AI-powered observations
- [Child Development & Progress](https://www.parent.app/child-development-progress): Child development tracking with curriculum builder and milestone monitoring
- [Attendance & Waitlist Software](https://www.parent.app/childcare-forms-attendance-software): Attendance tracking and waitlist management for childcare centers
- [Team Management](https://www.parent.app/effortless-team-management): Staff scheduling and team management for childcare operations
- [Daily Report App](https://www.parent.app/preschool-daily-report-app): Daily report app for real-time parent updates and activity tracking
